Maya (AE): Quick ask from ProspectBank: they want BYOK import, weekly rotation, signed per-batch attestation, and end-to-end key-op latency <=50ms in eu-west. Can we support and list immediate blockers?

Owen (Solutions Eng): doable but need topology. Is the 50ms end-to-end (client->our API->HSM) or only our HSM hop?

Maya (AE): they said end-to-end. Also they want optional split-key import (multi-custodian).

Sofia (Sales-Eng): Pricing check: do we charge for attestation generation and assisted import ceremonies in Dedicated/Private?

Raj (SRE): In-region HSM ops ~6-20ms; network/proxy adds ~10-30ms. To hit <=50ms we must colocate key-proxy with app and HSM in same AZ and use DEK caching. Split-key increases ceremony complexity but not latency for runtime ops.

Ellen (Security): Compliance: require FIPS Level 3 evidence and signed attestation PDF per import. We also need non-persistence language (no plaintext KEK stored) for their questionnaire. We can stream HSM audit events to customer SIEM (syslog/TLS).

Owen (Solutions Eng): Proposed POC runbook summary: exchange wrapping pubkey -> secure upload of wrapped parts -> import job -> generate signed attestation -> run unwrap/sign smoke tests -> weekly rotation cron with canary and auto-rollback. I'll draft details.

Sofia (Sales-Eng): I'll draft pricing: reserved capacity covers baseline HSM calls; BYOK import/attestation and assisted ceremony are add-ons.

Maya (AE): Action items: Owen -> runbook + API examples; Raj -> latency test script and topo diagram; Ellen -> security wording for questionnaire; Sofia -> quote. ops-bot, create task.

ops-bot: task created: sales/2812345678 -> BYOK-POC, assignees: [Owen, Raj, Ellen, Sofia], due: 3 business days

Raj (SRE): I'll post synthetic RTT numbers from eu-west before the kickoff.

Owen (Solutions Eng): will drop first draft runbook here by EOD tomorrow.

Maya (AE): thanks all, scheduling kickoff for Mon 09:00 CET.
